doc.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
doc.interviewee: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack")

title: Mary's earliest music memories: funeral bands
summary: Asked about the first music she remembered, Mary says she followed funeral bands all her life; Peter Bocage played in them.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: I was wondering, some of the very first music you ever heard in New Orleans, Mrs. Mack, if you can remember the very first band or dance music or parade music, any kind of music, when you were a little girl. Oh my goodness, all my life.
All my life. I've been following during the funerals and go sad and come back just to skip anything. They still have those.
What's the name of some of those bands that played around them? Of course, we know about Joe Oliver and that bunch, but there was two or three fellas that had pretty good bands around them.
I used to hear you talk about this. I know all of them.
Peter Bocard, he was in the band too. He blew, for funerals he'd blow a horn.
